title: In JetBrains CLion before 2026.3, 2026.2.4.1 missing authentication allowed local users to obtain the debug session…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains CLion before version 2026.3 and 2026.2.4.1 allows local users on Linux systems to access the debug session environment due to missing authentication. This issue could expose sensitive debug session information to unauthorized local users.
